### 📓 Docs Drift Check
Nothing in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **1** changed package(s)), so **this run has no opinion** about the docs.

- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `os serve (command, 38 pages)`
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **30** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 03de83bfe145eea8f495bcbc9886105715721b3f` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `916795acdc58203315ab384b3a1b9414fe863d6d`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .changeset/25158-refuse-plugin-auth-load-failure.md, content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx, content/docs/upgrading.mdx, packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts, packages/cli/test/fixtures/plugin-auth-load-failure.hook.mjs, packages/cli/test/serve-plugin-auth-load-failure-refusal.integration.test.ts, scripts/check-cli-test-child-env.mjs + packages/core/src/stack-auth.ts, packages/core/src/kernel.ts, packages/core/src/plugin-loader.ts, packages/types/src/module-not-found.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/start.ts, packages/cli/package.json, packages/cli/vitest.config.ts, packages/cli/vitest-tiers.ts, packages/cli/test/serve-no-auth-secret-refusal.integration.test.ts, packages/cli/test/helpers/serve-process.ts, packages/cli/test/fixtures/unbuilt-spec-dist.hook.mjs, scripts/measure-test-shard-timings.mjs, .github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/lint.yml, docs/adr/0131-total-organization-ownership-no-null-organization-id.md, AGENTS.md

Read-only and adversarial, by an isolated reviewer at this tier that the `domain:cli` seat's card thread dispatched; the thread adopts the verdict. Inputs: the net diff of PR #25231 against `main` at the head (7 files, +335 / -10), the PR body and file list, card #25158 with all three comments (retriage ask 6335791276, triage answer 6336751802, claim 6341648045), ruling 6328987873 on #25133, the prior record 6331012625 on #25155 (its B2 is this card), ADR-0131 D9 and its 2026-10-22 note, the sibling merge `ab488d9`, and the 49 check-runs on the head, all read from the GitHub API. The code was read at the head in the checkout. The six Test Core shard tails were read through the API: every shard is green, and the completeness guard is OK on all 17 scheduled packages. Nothing was built, run or re-run; the ablation is judged structurally from the pins.

### ① Derived judgments

**The accept-set change (the card's Fix, bullet 1).** Right.
- `serve.ts:4141` lifts `const productionBoot = !isDev` above the `5d` block. `isDev` is `isDevelopmentBoot(flags.dev)` at `:2414`, and `stack-auth.ts:135-137` reads it as `--dev` or `NODE_ENV === 'development'`.
- `:4149-4150` add `authPluginMounted` and `authPluginLoadFailure`. `:4320` sets the flag only after `await kernel.use(new AuthPlugin(...))` at `:4258` returns.
- The catch at `:4584-4595` records the message when `productionBoot && authComposition.composes && !authPluginMounted` (`:4586`). Otherwise it keeps the old branch verbatim (`:4591-4593`): silent for a module-not-found, one warning otherwise.
- The refusal at `:4742-4753` throws when a failure was recorded.
- `authComposition.composes` is true only when the stack mounts no AuthPlugin, the `auth` tier is on, the composition is not a host kernel and a secret resolved (`stack-auth.ts:179-183`).

So the refused set is exactly the card's third composition: a production `os serve` / `os start` with the `auth` tier on and a secret set, where the import, the construction or the `kernel.use` of AuthPlugin threw before the mount.

**Newly refused.** A production boot (no `--dev`, `NODE_ENV` not `development`) whose `@objectstack/plugin-auth` root entry is missing or broken. On `main` a missing entry was silent (`:4591`, `module-not-found.ts:19-21`) and a broken one gave one warning.
- It is refused with or without `--server`: the condition at `:4742` reads no transport.
- A migrate-and-exit job is included: `:5530` sits after `runtime.start()` at `:5462`.
- `os start` reaches it. `start.ts:472` forces `NODE_ENV=production` unless it is set, `:455` always hands a secret, and `:524-534` spawns `serve` with no `--dev`.

The PR body, the changeset's TO and `upgrading.mdx` say exactly this.

**Unchanged, each verified.**
- **`--dev` and `NODE_ENV=development`:** `productionBoot` is false, so `:4586` is false and `:4591` warns or stays silent as on `main`. The `--dev --no-server` control pins the warn line.
- **Host kernel:** `:4154` imports before the `host-kernel` warn at `:4170`, so a failed import on a host kernel lands in the catch with `composes: false` and keeps the old handling. The warn-only path at `:4170-4174` is untouched.
- **No secret:** `composes: false`, so the catch keeps the old handling, and the no-secret refusal at `:4719` then fires as before.
- **Auth tier off, or a stack-supplied AuthPlugin:** the boot never enters the block (`:4151`). The no-auth refusal at `:4690` is unchanged: its condition is the same text, and only the `const` moved.
- **Programmatic embedding** never runs this command.
- **A stack that mounts its own AuthPlugin** composes an organization object and is outside every refusal.

**Before any plugin starts, and before any write.** Right.
- The throw at `:4742` precedes `await runtime.start()` at `:5462`.
- `ObjectKernel.use` (`kernel.ts:347-377`) requires `state === 'idle'` and only validates and records, through `loadPlugin` (`plugin-loader.ts:162-195`: metadata, contract, version, signature, a map insert; no `init` and no `start`).
- The three refusals sit at the same point, after the stack-plugin loop (`:4598-4636`, registration only). A refused boot has imported the app's own `plugins` but started nothing.
- The pins assert the SQLite file is absent on both refused legs (`test:140`) and present on both controls (`:149`), the same proof the sibling pin carries.

**A throw after the mount is correctly kept off the refusal.** Right.
- After `:4320` every mount site has its own `try`: Setup/Account `:4333-4337`, Organizations `:4394-4407` and `:4453-4456` (each with its own fatal and `process.exit(1)` on a walled posture), Security `:4477-4496`, and Audit `:4575-4580`. The only unguarded code is `trackPlugin('Auth')` and the posture read at `:4369`.
- If one of those does reach the outer catch, `authPluginMounted` is true and the old warn applies. That boot has an AuthPlugin and an organization object, so the reason for the refusal is absent.
- A throw between the import and the mount (`:4183-4251`, env and base-URL reads) is recorded and refused. There is no AuthPlugin and no organization object then, so this is the safe direction.

**The refusal text** (`:4743-4752`). It names the state: auth enabled, a secret set, plugin-auth failed to load, AuthPlugin not composed, anonymous access denied, and no owner for any row. Then come `The load error: ` with the verbatim message, the remedy, and the fact that `--no-server` does not avoid it.
- The remedy works for the pinned cases. `@objectstack/plugin-auth` is in `packages/cli/package.json` `dependencies` (`:58`, entry `:79`, `workspace:*`), not optional or peer, so `npm ci` / `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` restores it.
- The text carries no tracker number and no angle-bracket fragment, and it does not offer `--no-server`.
- "Failed to load" reads a little wide for a construction throw (the PR's own note). The verbatim error line shows the actual cause either way.

**The stub** (`fixtures/plugin-auth-load-failure.hook.mjs`). It is a `node:module` `registerHooks` resolve/load hook (`:34`, `:55-66`), the same mechanism as `unbuilt-spec-dist.hook.mjs` (`:43`, `:60`), on CI's node 22.
- It denies only the root specifier (`:41`, `:57`), so `@objectstack/runtime`'s subpath imports stay reachable.
- `missing` hands `nextResolve` a path that does not exist (`:49`, `:58`), so node writes its own `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` sentence. That is the error `main` swallowed silently.
- `broken` short-circuits to a custom-scheme module whose static import of `createLocalAccountIssuer` from `node:path` cannot link (`:52-53`, `:59`, `:64`), so node writes its own `SyntaxError`, the publish-smoke shape.
- The fixture writes neither sentence.
- The hook runs in the same process as oclif (`node --import HOOK bin/run.js serve`), so it is in place before the boot imports anything.
- `@objectstack/verify` imports the root entry statically (`packages/verify/src/harness.ts:38`); `serve.ts` does not. The side effect is oclif's command-table warning for `verify`, and the test anchors past it by asserting right after `The load error: ` (`test:137`, `:53-56`).

**The pins** (`serve-plugin-auth-load-failure-refusal.integration.test.ts`). Four legs through `bin/run.js`. Each sets `NODE_ENV: undefined` last (`:103`), sets `OS_AUTH_SECRET` (`:97`), leaves the legacy spellings unset, and builds its env with `childEnv` (`serve-process.ts:881-890`).
- **Refused legs** (`:131-142`) assert a non-null, non-zero exit code, no ready banner, the load-failure text, `The load error: ` followed by node's own opening, no `⚠ AuthPlugin failed to load` line, and no database file. They are a missing install with `--server` (`:171`) and a broken install with `--no-server` (`:175`).
- **Controls** (`:145-151`): with no stub, the same fixture and secret under `--no-server` reach ready and open the database (`:179`). The broken stub under `--dev --no-server` reaches ready and prints the warn line with node's sentence (`:183-186`).
- **Ablation, judged structurally.** With the recording condition off, a stubbed production boot falls to `:4591` (silent or a warning). No other refusal fires, because the tier is on and a secret resolved, so the boot reaches ready and `exitCode` is `null`. `:133` then reds with "the boot was not refused" on both refused legs, and both controls are unaffected: two red and two green, as the PR reports.
- **The stub is the cause:** the no-stub control differs only in the hook, and the `--dev` control only in posture.
- **Location:** beside `serve-no-auth-secret-refusal.integration.test.ts`, as the card asked.
- **The pin runs on every PR.** The nightly cut selects `*.e2e`/`*.live` by name only (`vitest.config.ts:598-608`), and this file is `*.integration`. Both projects run under the package's plain `vitest run` (`package.json:29`, `vitest.config.ts:870-895`), and `@objectstack/cli` is a directly changed package under `turbo --affected` (`ci.yml:615`, `:686`). Test Core 1/6 through 6/6 are green, and every shard's completeness guard reports all tests accounted for.

**The gate** (`scripts/check-cli-test-child-env.mjs:2638-2686`). The self-test pins the built-entrypoint population as a SET of files, so a spawner joining it has to be seen by a PR. The new pin spawns `bin/run.js` and is named at `:2686`, with the same reason shape as `:2672`. The non-self-test run holds every spawn in the population to `NODE_ENV: undefined`, which `test:103` satisfies. `Lint & Repo Gates` and every `Lint ·` job are green, the `CLI test child-env guard` step among them (`lint.yml:2724`).

**Check-runs on the head.** 49 runs, 0 failed, 0 pending.
- **Success:** Build Core; Test Core (the aggregate and 1/6 through 6/6); TypeScript Type Check with all four `Type Check ·` jobs; Lint & Repo Gates with all eight `Lint ·` jobs; Check Changeset (both instances); Governed Surface Queue Guard; Spec property liveness; Check Documentation Links; Build Docs; Dogfood Regression Gate; the four claim/path guards; Flag docs affected.
- **Skipped:** the opt-in tarball smoke and the 18.x harness, Console Pin Gate, Temporal Conformance, Dogfood Verify CLI, the matrix template row, and one duplicate each of Check PR Size and Auto Label.

### ② Semver level

The changeset carries:
- `'@objectstack/cli': patch` (`.changeset/...:2`);
- the BREAKING banner (`:12`), FROM and TO (`:14-15`), Unchanged (`:17`) and the remedy (`:19`);
- `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, at the start of their lines in the changeset (`:7-8`) and in the PR body;
- exactly one ADR-0087 marker, `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` (`:10`).

That is the level AGENTS.md "Post-Task Checklist" step 3 gives a non-protocol narrowing: `patch`, keeping its BREAKING banner and its ADR-0087 disposition. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right, because no key, value, type, default or meaning that a metadata author writes changes. The title carries `!`, and `Check Changeset` is green.

Every sentence of the changeset is true against the code:
- "silently" for a missing install (`module-not-found.ts:19-21` plus `serve.ts:4591`), and "one warning" for a broken one;
- "with or without `--server`" and "the database is never opened";
- the construction-throw sentence (`:4586` keys on the mount flag);
- the Unchanged list;
- the remedy's dependency claim (`package.json:79`, under `dependencies`).

`packages/cli/CHANGELOG.md` is untouched, as it must be. The docs are true against the code: `cli.mdx:405-407`, and `upgrading.mdx:419-424` and `:432-434`, including "`os start` included" and the re-scoping of the `os start` sentence to the missing-secret refusal. `content/docs/releases/**` is untouched.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **B1 (not blocking).** PR acceptance note 1: the refusal also covers a construction throw before the mount, under one "failed to load" sentence. Answered: the state is identical (no AuthPlugin, no organization object), ADR-0131 D9 refuses it, and the verbatim error names the stage, so the one-sentence text is accepted. The remedy sentence fits the two pinned shapes and might not fit a throw from `serve.ts:4183-4251`, but no such throw site is apparent there.
- **B2 (not blocking).** PR acceptance note 2: `os start`'s `serve` child is a production boot, so a broken install under `os start` is now refused. Answered: this is correct and intended (`start.ts:472`, `:455`, `:524-534`). The ruling's letter A names `os start`, and the changeset's FROM and `upgrading.mdx:420` say so. It is not pinned under `os start` itself; it follows from the code.
- **B3 (not blocking).** The cross-lane touch of `scripts/check-cli-test-child-env.mjs` (`:2638`, `:2680-2686`). The gate's own census demands the entry, and the edit is the minimal one: a count word and one annotated path. The lint gate is green on it and the PR body declares it. The seat should note it to the lane that owns `scripts/`.
- **B4 (not blocking).** Four files exceed the claim's file surface: the hook fixture, the two docs pages and the gate script. The PR body explains each one, as the claim's "stop on breach; explain" requires, and the docs follow the pattern of ruling 6328987873 item 4.
- **B5 (not blocking).** The pin's `test-budget` SECONDS comes from a local reading (`test:2`), and the grammar asks for the CI reading. The line parses, and its reader is report-only.
- **B6 (not blocking).** `start.ts:147` still describes a missing secret as "auth is silently skipped". That has been stale since #25155 and is outside this diff.
- **B7 (not blocking).** Two cases are not pinned: a host kernel with a load failure, and a migrate-and-exit job with a load failure. Both hold structurally (`stack-auth.ts:181`, and the code path shared with the sibling's pinned migrate leg).
- **The branch** `claude/project-thread-m47h05` does not follow the `claude/issue-25158-*` convention. The claim states the platform constraint, and both "The card this PR closes must claim this branch" runs are green.
